tranches.name: Character Knowledge, Experience & Explicit Familiarity Records

active_contract.qualification_semantics: explicit visible canonical-owner evidence resolves qualified/unqualified; missing or explicit-unknown remains unknown; incompatible remains incompatible
active_contract.kfr_advisory_boundary: KFR-03 familiarity and KFR-04 transfer/confidence are explanatory only and never grant or upgrade qualification
active_contract.station_authority_boundary: active VehicleStationGrant authority is projected separately and never proves qualification; KFR-05 does not mutate grants
active_contract.vehicle_equipment_boundary: MIB-14 vehicle/platform/base/mecha/ship and D17 Asset/equipment identities/state are read-only canonical integration references
active_contract.action_authority_boundary: qualified projection is evidence only and grants no permission, executable action authority, ownership or custody
active_contract.persistence_decision: no durable KFR-05 persistence; migration 0022 remains unreserved

boundaries: KFR-01 through KFR-04 are completed_verified with implementation authority retired.
KFR-05 is bounded in_progress only on its registered branch after owner Continue plus green governed-start merge.
Only explicit canonical-owner qualification evidence may resolve qualification; familiarity, transfer, confidence, station grants and configuration acceptance cannot automatically create it.
Canonical Character, Progression/Skill, Vehicle/platform, D17 Asset/Equipment, domain-owner and Permission/visibility state remain authoritative.
No permission/action grant, proficiency/certification mutation, ownership/custody mutation, canonical mutation, durable KFR-05 persistence or migration 0022.
KFR-06+, ODL-01+, tester distribution, paid provider activation, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
